newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets dull, lack impetus.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets dull, lack impetus.

text.p: Europe's cotton markets fell silent on Thursday save for a whisper of enquiry for Central Asian and West African medium better qualities for Spring and early Summer delivery, industry sources.
But the buying interest, reported by traders in Portugal, France and Germany failed to translate into firm contracts, they said.
Range-bound New York futures and a strong U.S. dollar kept buyers at bay and there was no market-moving fundamental news to nudge either buyers or sellers into action.
The long staple sector also saw dull, featureless trade and only routine business was evident in Eastern Europe, market sources said. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
